interview_parser_agent.name: Interview Parser Agent
interview_parser_agent.description: Extracts discrete findings, user quotes, pain points, feature requests, and behavioral observations from raw interview notes

theme_categorizer_agent.name: Theme Categorizer Agent
theme_categorizer_agent.description: Groups parsed findings into themes, tags by category (pain point, feature request, workflow issue), and prioritizes by impact and frequency

summary_generator_agent.name: Summary Generator Agent
summary_generator_agent.description: Produces executive summary with top 3-5 insights, prioritized action items with impact scores, and cross-references findings against product roadmap context

research_analysis_manager.name: Research Analysis Manager
research_analysis_manager.description: Coordinates the interview analysis pipeline — routes raw notes to parsing, theme categorization, and summary generation sub-agents, then aggregates into final structured output

stakeholder_distribution_agent.name: Stakeholder Distribution Agent
stakeholder_distribution_agent.description: Sends the approved summary to Slack channels, emails it via Gmail to specified stakeholders, creates a structured Notion page, logs action items as GitHub issues, and creates a Google Calendar follow-up event

workflow.flow: input_node -> research_analysis_manager -> [interview_parser_agent, theme_categorizer_agent, summary_generator_agent] -> stakeholder_distribution_agent -> output_node
